list.row: "About thirty documents" (Part 1, Part 2) and "the 30 documents I selected" | Section 5; section 4 (30 documents of the collection); M9 (30 pairs)
list.sentence: I counted only information, cultural, educational and psychological programs aimed at the region, so economic aid and military presence are left out as instruments; counting them would turn the question into one about aid and bases, which this set does not address. **What the region includes.** I took China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and the Pacific and left out South Asia; if you want India's audience, the search must be widened to its volumes. **What counts as policymaker.** I included field officers and the Agency's researchers as well as presidents, secretaries and ambassadors; restricting it to the senior group would drop the field reports on which much of the evidence on effectiveness rests. **What counts as effective.** I took the officials' own verdicts and the Agency's surveys, because the edition prints no outcome measure; a stricter rule would leave only the surveys. **Whose beliefs count as evidence.** I treat what an official believed about an audience as the official's belief and never as evidence of the audience's views.
